body_markdown:
*Master-Planned Community Brings Resort-Style Amenities and Spacious Home Designs to Henry County*


MCDONOUGH, Ga.


, Oct. 22, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Lennar, one of the nation's leading homebuilders, today announced the grand opening of King Oaks, a master-planned community of new single-family homes now selling in McDonough, Georgia. Offering ample onsite amenities and spacious open-concept floorplans, King Oaks brings resort-inspired living to McDonough, with everyday conveniences close by.


"King Oaks brings an amenity-rich lifestyle to McDonough without giving up the everyday conveniences families expect," said Scott Withington, Division President of Lennar's Atlanta Division. "Offering larger homesites, an ideal location, and onsite amenities that cater to all ages, there's something here for every stage of life. We're proud to bring this community to Henry County."


King Oaks features eight Lennar home designs, including single-family ranch and two-story floorplans with a variety of exterior elevations. Homes range from 2,552 to 3,660 square feet with three to five bedrooms and three to four-and-a-half bathrooms. Open-concept layouts and flexible living spaces anchor every design, with select floorplans offering first-floor guest accommodations. Pricing starts in the high-$400,000s.


Every home at King Oaks comes with Lennar's[Everything's Included®](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4804020-1&h=3932423618&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lennar.com%2Fproductsandservices%2Feverythings-included&a=Everything%27s+Included%C2%AE) program, where popular features and finishes are built into the base price of the home. For homes in King Oaks, this includes smart home offerings for everyday convenience.


King Oaks residents can enjoy a resort-style swimming pool, a clubhouse with gathering spaces, community parks, a dog park and walking trails, all designed to promote outdoor recreation and carefree living. The community is conveniently located near the ample local shopping, dining, and community events that Historic Downtown McDonough boasts. South Point Shopping Center, a 900,000-square-foot retail, dining and entertainment destination, is approximately five miles away. Golf enthusiasts can explore Georgia National Golf Club, featuring a Denis Griffiths-designed course and membership opportunities, while nearby Heritage Park and Salem Park offer walking trails, sports fields and outdoor recreation.


King Oaks is located within the Henry County School District, with access to East Lake Elementary School, Union Grove Middle School and Union Grove High School, giving families the benefit of established schools while keeping shopping, dining and recreation close by.


For more information on King Oaks, call (470) 945-9773 or visit the[community website](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4804020-1&h=1517810604&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lennar.com%2Fnew-homes%2Fgeorgia%2Fatlanta%2Fmcdonough%2Fking-oaks&a=community+website) .


**About Lennar Corporation**
Lennar Corporation, founded in 1954, is one of the nation's leading builders of quality homes for all generations. Lennar builds affordable, move-up and active adult homes primarily under the Lennar brand name. Lennar's Financial Services segment provides mortgage financing, title and closing services primarily for buyers of Lennar's homes and, through LMF Commercial, originates mortgage loans secured primarily by commercial real estate properties throughout the United States. Lennar's Multifamily segment is a nationwide developer of high-quality multifamily rental properties. LENX drives Lennar's technology, innovation and strategic investments.
